_doc: Twin physics numbers (sim/twin/physics/apply.py). Units: m, kg, N m, rad. See README.md for sources and the measurements behind each choice.

finray._doc: XLeRobot TPU fin-ray fingers (sim/twin/gripper). material = the fin contact surface (TPU on ABS); compliant contact stiffness in N/m per contact point; grasp_depth = TIP_LOCAL height above the fin tip (m); extend = experiment switch; tip_local = explicit [x, y, z] override. bias_rad -0.10 = the linear servo map fitted on open wrist frames (q = 0.0229 u - 0.099; perception's jaw_fit 0.02406 u - 0.118); effort 0.74 N m = LeRobot so_follower gripper Overload_Torque 25 % of the 12 V STS3215 stall (Max_Torque_Limit 50 % = 1.47 N m peak)

bend._doc: bending TPU fins (sim/twin/gripper/model.py): hinges per fin (0 = rigid fin); slices true = a 12 mm clamped root (root_len) + N equal slices, false = cut at the CAD convex pieces (1-3 hinges); stiffness N m/rad and damping N m s/rad per hinge (scalar or list root -> tip; stiffness_jaw_nm_per_rad optional for the moving fin); segment mass kg; joint limit deg; curl_gearing = mimic coupling of the distal hinges (unstable, keep 0); rest_curl_deg = distal pre-curl toward the other fin (deg; 8 seats the brick 2 mm deeper but lifts 72 % vs 78 %)

table._doc: varnished table top. combine min + fins average + bricks max gives the pairs: fin-table 0.15 (the TPU fin tip slides when the jaw sweeps over the table), brick-table 0.45 / 0.38 (the brick's own value), fin-brick 0.9 / 0.8 (the fin's)

contact._doc: real Duplo shell collider (studs, hollow underside, tubes; LDraw dimensions) + mesh inertia; contact/hook.py. With play on: lift 88.9 % vs box 72.8 % (n=60 x3, --place fk); pushes stay realistic.
